name: Sourdough Monkey Bread
instructions: Mix starter, flour, water, butter/oil, honey, and salt in stand mixer 5 min until silky and slightly sticky.
Place in greased bowl, cover, ferment 6–12 hours until doubled.
In a gallon bag, shake cinnamon and sugar together. Add balls, shake to coat. Continue until all dough is gone.
Grease bundt pan. Add 2 Tbl maple syrup to bottom.
Arrange cinnamon sugar balls in pan. Proof 2 hours. (Tip: briefly warm oven, turn off, proof in warm oven.)
Melt butter in saucepan. Mix in ½ cup maple syrup. Remove from heat; add vanilla.
Pour caramel sauce over proofed balls.
Immediately place plate on top of pan and flip. Lift away pan. Serve warm.
notes: Double the caramel sauce if preferred. Bundt pan alternatives noted at simpleisgourmet.com.
